scripts.name: Close Background Apps
scripts.description: Closes background apps before a game and reopens them after; run as Administrator, it also pauses Windows Update for the game.
scripts.author: stephenh678
scripts.scriptArguments: "recommended" for the recommended list (OneDrive, Dropbox, Google Drive, Creative Cloud, Teams, Slack), and/or process names to close, separated by spaces; empty does nothing

scripts.name: Companion Apps
scripts.description: Starts the tools a game needs when it launches and closes them when it exits.
scripts.author: stephenh678
scripts.scriptArguments: full paths of the programs to start, each in double quotes

scripts.name: OBS Replay Buffer
scripts.description: Runs OBS in the tray with the replay buffer on while you play, then closes it.
scripts.author: stephenh678
scripts.scriptArguments: optional OBS profile name, in double quotes
scripts.dependencies: OBS Studio 30 or newer, with the replay buffer set up

scripts.name: Save Backup
scripts.description: Zips a game's save folder before and after you play and keeps the newest ten.
scripts.author: stephenh678
scripts.scriptArguments: the save folder in double quotes, then optionally a backup folder

scripts.name: Wallpaper Engine Pause
scripts.description: Pauses and mutes Wallpaper Engine while you play, then resumes it.
scripts.author: stephenh678
